[[File:Mytag_crystal.png|thumb|right]]
'''Mytag crystals''' were synthetic [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] used in ancient communication and [[Scanner|scanning]] technology. [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] had a large stockpile of these crystals among other war materials, such as [[Blaster/Legends|beam tubes]] and [[Kiirium/Legends|kiirium]] ingots. In Xim's day, these represented the pinnacle of military technology and were invaluable; however, by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], advances in technology had made them obsolete and worthless.<ref name="Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>

Xim's vast treasure horde was the stuff of galactic legend, said to have been loaded aboard his ship, the [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']], which was subsequently lost in [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. Generations of treasure hunters sought it out, until 1 BBY when a group that included smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|S. V. Skynx]] discovered the horde in the [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot]]. Solo was disappointed to learn the treasure was now worthless, though Skynx was ecstatic about the find's historical value.<ref name="Legacy" />

The [[Ark of Baron Auletphant]] was inlaid with [[Color/Legends|rose]] and azure mytag crystals.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
